messages:
lee: FYI PR #21456 is green locally but blocked in the e2e queue, need a merge window before the weekend freeze. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/21456
ci-bot: Pipeline queued: e2e/full-matrix for PR #21456 (position 42 in queue) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
anya: ugh 42? ok. what's the ETA on that queue usually during peak?
morgan: last night it took ~3.5h at position ~30. today might be slower bc of nightly canaries.
lee: we have a small db migration in this PR, so prefer landing during a low-traffic canary or staggered roll rather than a big batch. not urgent but prefer before maintenance blackout on sunday.
oliver: can we backfill by prioritizing the e2e job for this PR? ops would need to bump priority or give a short rebase window to land in the next slot.
anya: @oliver can you check if we have a spare canary slot at 21:00 UTC? if not, we should ask for a small reserved window.
oliver: pinged infra. they said canary slots are almost full but might open one if we can promise <5% traffic and a quick rollback plan.
morgan: rollback is standard: toggle feature flag + revert deploy. db migration has a fast forward-only step though — need a migration lock.
lee: migration is additive and guarded by the feature flag, so safe to ship canary-first. still require approvals from @anya for schema.
anya: I reviewed the schema change, it's fine. leaving a small comment on the PR about the lock and rollout steps.
lee: thanks. two asks: 1) can someone nudge CI to prioritize the e2e job (backfill)? 2) if no slot, request a staggered landing plan: land to 1 canary region, monitor 10m, then rollout remainder.
ci-bot: Requested priority bump for PR #21456: e2e/full-matrix -> priority medium. Current position 17.
oliver: infra confirmed a canary slot at 21:05 UTC if we can keep rollout to 2 regions and revert plan in place.
morgan: I'll be on-call and can watch metrics. if we see error rate >0.5% or latency increase >30% we'll abort.
lee: perfect. @anya final approval?
anya: approved. left two tiny nits but not blocking.
lee: ok landing plan: rebase now, trigger CI, aim for 21:05 canary. steps in PR description: ```bash
# rebase onto main
git checkout pr/21456
git fetch origin main
git rebase origin/main
push --force-with-lease
```
lee: tagging reviewers and oncall: @morgan @oliver please be ready 21:00-21:30 UTC. I'll kick off rebase at 20:40 to give CI time.
morgan: I'll grab coffee and watch dashboards. :coffee:
oliver: infra will standby to open additional canaries if needed.
ci-bot: Pipeline passed: unit & integration. e2e position now 5 in queue.
lee: thanks all, will rebase in ~10m and ping when CI starts the matrix.
anya: good luck :thumbsup:
